target_customer: Nigerians and the Nigerian diaspora who receive or send USD and other foreign currency payments
problem: People in emerging markets struggle to receive foreign payments, hold stable currency and pay internationally due to inflation and limited banking access.
business_model: Fintech fees on payments, FX and cards plus savings yield
product_category: Cross-border USD accounts and stablecoin-backed neobank

founders.name: Tolu Alabi
education: Grinnell College, BA in computer science and mathematics
founders.background_notes: YC page: lead PM on Stripe Issuing and Banking, senior PM at Amazon.

founders.name: Philip Abel
education: MIT and Georgia Tech, computer science (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Originally from Nigeria per YC page.

competitors.name: Payday
competitors.what: Payments for Nigerians receiving foreign income

technical_complexity.rationale: Banking-as-a-service, card issuing and payments rails integration with compliance requirements; standard fintech engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Multiple competitors offered similar USD accounts; a Central Bank of Nigeria IMTO licence in 2025 adds some regulatory position.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors coexisted; no acquisition found in a 2025 news search.

market_need_then: TechCrunch Jan 2024 reports about $1M monthly payments within four months of an August 2023 launch and thousands of Nigerians opening US-based accounts; naira depreciation drove demand for USD.

identity.logo: not described; gold coin accent in imagery
identity.visual_style: Phone-based scenes, coin and points graphics
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and emotional, tagline Love across borders

branding.brand_signature: Cleva Points rewards and the tagline Love across borders
branding.community_and_virality: Business Post reports a referral bonus campaign; customer counts reported by the company.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive short name and a clear emotional message with a referral program; evidence of brand pull is limited to company reported growth.

outcome_analysis: Cleva is active after raising a $1.5M pre-seed in January 2024 led by 1984 Ventures and reports over 500,000 Nigerian customers by August 2025 per its blog. Nigerian founders with Stripe and AWS experience, naira depreciation and a 2025 money transfer licence support growth. Crowded competition remains.
notes: Pre-seed confirmed by TechCrunch and Nairametrics. Later rounds not found; coverage kept partial. Customer counts are company claims relayed by press snippets. The 500,000 customer figure comes from a search snippet of the company blog.
